class.name: GameplayReplicationState
class.brief_description: Runtime values, revisions, dirty state, conditions, and RepNotify dispatch.
class.description: GameplayReplicationState is independent of a concrete transport. An authority collects peer-specific update dictionaries, while a receiver applies only newer revisions. Object decoding is not allowed by the multiplayer adapter.

method.name: add_property
method.description: Adds a unique descriptor and its current value.

method.name: apply_updates
method.description: Applies known properties with newer positive revisions and dispatches RepNotify after a value change.

method.name: collect_updates
method.description: Returns eligible dirty updates and records successful collection time for frequency throttling.

method.name: get_change_serial
method.description: Returns a monotonic local serial advanced by descriptor additions/removals and authoritative dirty value changes. The replication graph uses it to detect changes made after dormancy begins.

method.name: is_property_dirty
method.description: Returns whether any registered peer still needs the current revision.

method.name: is_property_dirty_for_peer
method.description: Returns whether the peer still needs the current revision.

method.name: mark_property_dirty
method.description: Advances the revision without changing the value.

method.name: register_peer
method.description: Registers a recipient. Initial-only properties become eligible for a new peer ID.

method.name: reset_peer_updates
method.description: Restores collected updates to dirty state after a transport or fragmentation failure.

method.name: remove_property
method.description: Removes a descriptor and runtime history.

method.name: set_property_value
method.description: Stores a changed value and advances its revision.

method.name: unregister_peer
method.description: Removes all delivery history for a peer.

members.member: Optional callable receiving property name, old value, and new value.

signal.name: property_rep_notified
signal.description: Emitted when a RepNotify property changes from an accepted remote update.
